data.title: Islamic Affairs Ministry Holds Training Course for Imams and Students of Islamic Knowledge in Peru
data.content:
Lima, November 22, 2026 SPA -- The Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance, represented by the King Fahd Cultural Center in Argentina, is organizing a five-day Shariah scientific course in Lima, the capital of Peru.
    The course aims to train approximately 120 imams, preachers, muezzins, and students of Islamic knowledge.
    The course is designed to enhance participants’ knowledge of Islamic teachings, strengthen their academic and preaching capabilities, and equip them to raise awareness in their communities and disseminate the tolerant teachings of Islam.
    The initiative is part of the ministry’s ongoing scientific and dawah programs implemented in various countries worldwide. These programs aim to qualify those engaged in Islamic affairs, strengthen their capacity to disseminate Islamic knowledge derived from the Holy Quran and Sunnah, and address extremist ideologies.
-- SPA
